_note: Build phases for the SCIENTIFIC NARRATIVE ATLAS. Ordered so that every layout decision is made against real measured coverage rather than being retrofitted. Total 47 person-days; phases 0-8 plus P9's narrative minimum are the 22-day publishable subset.

phases.name: Phase 0 - Decide, ask, and set the invariants (1.5 d)
phases.deliverable: A repo skeleton (bake/, app/, data/, tours/, verify/, copy/), a checked-in data/theme.json extracted from _shared/manuscript_style.py, a constants module holding the coordinate rule and the value domains, and three questions in the author's inbox.
exit_criteria: theme.json exists and records: modules M1 #0072B2, M2 #CC79A7, M3 #E69F00, M4 #D55E00, M5 #4D4D4D, M6 #009E73 (the MCOL dict that 24_bipartite_pruned_ordered.py:63, 23_bipartite_pruned_by_consensus.py:60, 15_annotated_bipartite_all6_boxed.py:50 and consensus_fig_lib.py:32 all agree on), with an explicit note that this OVERRIDES the CATEGORICAL-cycle variant in motif_umap/make_individual_figures.py and the unimplemented proposal in _shared/COLOR_TABLE.md lines 531-536; regions utr5 #E69F00 / utr3 #A85A00 / cds #009E73 / protein #0072B2; network label colours 5'UTR #0072B2 / 3'UTR #A85A00 / protein black; NT_COLORS A #009E73 C #0072B2 G #E69F00 U #D55E00; the examples_lib aacol scheme; and the deviation note that grey is reserved for M5 so unassigned nodes use a dashed outline instead.

constants.js and constants.py both export: SLICE = seq[start : end+1] (inclusive both ends), PLDDT_DOMAIN = [0, 1] (NOT 0-100), MOTIF_SCORE_DOMAIN = [-4.83, 0] (always negative), NTSCORE_DOMAIN = [-4, 0], JOIN_KEY = 'refseq_id_without_ver'.

Three questions sent to the author: (1) the utr3_0027 vs utr3_0227 conflict on the MLXIPL / M2 example - BLOCKING for the M2 story card, the M2 tour and the Fig 4a verify page; (2) include the SOX2 design story (Fig 5/6)? (3) include mouse? A top-level nav slot named 'Design' is reserved and hidden.
A one-page IA sketch approved: the six question-to-view mappings, and the decision that the landing page leads with the modules and NOT with a search box, with the omnibox as permanent chrome.

phases.name: Phase 1 - Bake the corrected master table and the canonical cluster table (4 d)
phases.deliverable: bake/01_master.py and bake/02_clusters.py producing L1/motifs_master.parquet (889,215 rows, ID-bearing, region-correct) and L1/clusters.json (900 rows) - the two artifacts every later step reads.
exit_criteria: The two contract assertions run first and pass: r1/s05_full.py proves seq[start:end+1] == motifs for 889,215/889,215 rows in ~0.5 s, and the build refuses to emit if it fails; r1/s18_verify_filter.py reproduces all eight published coverage percentages exactly (rbp 51.358%, mirna 4.698%, interpro 67.758%, elm 0.313%, uniprot 90.201%, mobidb 87.206%, idpo 0.750%, signalp 0.117%).
MobiDB / IDPO / SignalP are masked to region=='protein', removing 209,959 + 1,825 + 665 = 212,449 spurious annotation rows. The masked table is what everything downstream uses.

No comma-joined string is ever split. InterPro comes from processed/01.interpro/motif_interpro_annotations.parquet overlapping_interpro_labels (15,216 distinct IPRs); UniProt from a fresh typed join against processed/03.uniprot/uniprot_annotation.parquet with the 0-based-corrected overlap rule (756,192 hits over 231,439 motifs, ~2 min); ELM from raw_annotations/02.elm/elm_instances.tsv; IDPO from processed/05.idpo/motif_idpo_annotations.parquet idpo_ids. The original strings survive only as *_legacy_string and are never rendered.

L1/clusters.json has 900 rows, each with region, module (null for 387), a three-tier name with its tier recorded, size stats, composition, the 20-bin positional histogram and median_pos, and partner counts at both thresholds. NO other artifact re-derives cluster->module from modules.json.

The recomputed positional histograms reproduce streme_pos_cache_all6.pkl for all 142 overlapping clusters (spot-checked: utr3_0215 median_pos 0.4441 / n_instances 566; utr5_0090 median_pos 0.791; prot_0135 median_pos 0.483).

annotation_results/motif_interpro_overlap_summary.csv is explicitly excluded from the build (297,686 rows from an older motif run; joining it on raw_motif_index matches the current motif string in 1 of 297,686 rows).

phases.name: Phase 2 - Fill the STREME gap and build the logo bundle (2.5 d)
phases.deliverable: L1/logos.json covering as much of the 900 as STREME can support, each PWM tagged provenance, plus L1/instance_match.parquet giving every instance its best PWM window, bits and carrier tier.
exit_criteria: windows_fasta(), run_streme(), parse_streme(), cons_of() and coverage() are copied VERBATIM from motif_pair_network/16_consensus_repertoire.py so new PWMs are method-identical to the 513 on disk (MAXSEQ 1200, NMOTIFS 12, P_SIG 0.05, COV_BITS 0.5; streme --p <fa> --n background_sequences_{region}.fasta --oc <dir> --nmotifs 12, plus --protein --minw 6 --maxw 15 or --rna --minw 5 --maxw 12).

The 387 never-run clusters have been attempted. Budget: measured 64.3 s for a protein cluster and 5-10 s for a UTR cluster, ~2.4 CPU-hours single-threaded, ~15 min at WORKERS=10. Expect ~100-150 protein clusters to still return nothing significant (prot_0002 already did).
THE NUMBER IS RECORDED: how many of 900 clusters end up with a logo. Phase 7 lays out the cluster page against THIS number, not against the pre-refill 466.

Every logo carries provenance: 'STREME (published)' / 'STREME (portal refill)' / 'derived PFM'. No logo is ever produced by stacking member strings (only 32 of 900 clusters have >=50% of members at the modal length).

instance_match.parquet reproduces the m4_motif_examples hand-checked numbers: utr5_0096#0 AGCAGA coverage 0.253 / 70 carriers; utr5_0096#2 UCAUC 0.150 / 64; utr3_0215#0 UCUCC 0.511 / 155; of 1,988 M4 member transcripts, 106 literal-and-carrier and 53 tier A.

phases.name: Phase 3 - Bake the shipped shards and the search index (3.5 d)
phases.deliverable: data/seq/, data/gene/, data/cluster/, data/search_index.json.gz, data/clusters_index.json, data/excluded.json.
exit_criteria: The sequence table is deduplicated on refseq_id_without_ver BEFORE any join (21,667 -> 19,210; verified lossless, 0 of 1,296 duplicate groups differ in utr3_sequence or protein_sequence). Skipping this inflates the join to 20,481 and duplicates motif tracks.
NTScore arrays are extracted from both h5 caches, verified length-exact against their region sequence, int8-quantised, and written into the sequence shards. The 169.5 MB h5 never ships.

Measured sizes are met or beaten: sequence shards ~17.74 MB total (p50 850 B, max 2,720 B); gene shards ~46.61 MB (p50 2,369 B, p99 6,251 B, max 11,301 B); cluster shards ~41.98 MB (p50 43,770 B, max 217,326 B); search index 0.157 MB gz.
Enrichment is de-duplicated on (cluster, source, display) keeping min fdr_cluster before it enters any cluster shard, and prot_0072's top 3 no longer reads 'phase separation (curated)' three times.
data/excluded.json lists all 1,117 motif-free transcripts with a reason; the 666 that exceed the 7,784 nt model context are labelled as such and TTN / NM_001267550 / 37,239 nt resolves correctly.

The ACTB fixture passes end to end from the shard alone: 3 5'UTR, 13 3'UTR, 4 protein motifs; all three 5'UTR motifs in utr5_0004; TIAL1 on the 45-nt AU-rich element at [82,126]; prot_0040 'DDAPR' at [23,27] with InterPro Actin family.

phases.name: Phase 4 - Bake the R3 graph bundle and freeze the layout (3 d)
exit_criteria: meta_edges.json is COMPUTED (it exists nowhere on disk) and matches the measured weights: M1-M2 244, M1-M5 192, M2-M3 167, M1-M6 32, M1-M3 30, M2-M5 28, M3-M4 22, M5-M6 15, M3-M6 6, M2-M4 5, M2-M6 5, M3-M5 5, M4-M5 4, M1-M4 1, M4-M6 1 - summing to 757 cross-module edges, with 1,860 intra and 3 unassigned.

The node layout is frozen from one d3-force run with per-module attractors and a protein-left / UTR-right bias, and module blocks are ordered by node_select.order_modules(). Reloading the page reproduces the layout byte for byte, so deep links are stable. The pair-UMAP is NOT used for node placement (averaging it collapses M1/M2/M5/M6).
edges.json holds all 2,620 gated edges with their ten statistical fields (89 KB gz); the relaxed 7,210-row slice is a separate lazy file (0.74 MB).

edge_genes/ holds a precomputed carrier list per displayed edge from the Pc & Uc bitwise AND, and reproduces the three known sets exactly: 13 M3 genes for prot_0122#0 & utr5_0090#0; 15 for prot_0072#0 & utr5_0079#0; 17 histones for prot_0040#0 & utr3_0463#0.

umap.bin is <= 1.0 MB gzipped (measured 0.994 MB as uint16 xy + uint16 npmi + uint8 module) and joins 180,000/180,000 to protein_utr_FINAL_scores.csv. cca_winner_umap.npy and row_index.csv are COPIED into the snapshot with their source path, mtime and SHA-256 recorded, because they live in a v3 tree nothing else references.
manifest.json records every input's absolute path, bytes, mtime and SHA-256, plus the snapshot version, the build timestamp and the eight reproduced coverage percentages.

phases.name: Phase 5 - App shell and chrome (3 d)
phases.deliverable: index.html + the router, data loader with LRU shard cache, theme system, omnibox, caveat strip, breadcrumb/resolution selector, export basket, glossary drawer.
exit_criteria: First paint is <= 334 KB (shell ~150 KB + search index 157 KB + modules.json 2 KB + consensus_meta 18 KB + cluster_term_labels 7 KB) and time-to-interactive is measured, not assumed.
Every route in the routing table resolves, is deep-linkable, and restores its filter state from the URL.
The three-state theme works in all three states; every chart reads colours from CSS custom properties, so no chart re-renders on a theme change.
The omnibox resolves gene symbols, RefSeq, ENSG, ENST and U/T-normalised motif strings entirely client-side, with zero network round-trips per keystroke.
The caveat strip is present and non-dismissible on #/network, #/pair, #/module and #/cluster, and quotes module_gene_members/README.md verbatim.
A grep of the codebase finds no occurrence of 'binds' or 'interacts with' in any template. The data-model field is named co_occurrence.

phases.name: Phase 6 - R1: the gene / transcript view (6 d)
phases.deliverable: V10 complete: three region panels with sequence lanes, NTScore tracks, protein feature tracks, four CLIP lanes, the miRNA lane, the motif table, the module fingerprint, and all three empty states.
exit_criteria: DAY-ONE MEASUREMENT, before any layout is committed: render NM_001351027 (7,784 nt total) and NM_001003665 (381 segments) against the already-built shards at /private/tmp/.../scratchpad/r1/full_shards/ and record paint time and memory. If DOM spans fail, the tracks move to a single canvas layer while the sequence text stays in DOM (risk R-02).
One span per motif-or-gap segment, never per nucleotide; a single flat lane per region with no interval packing (max stacking depth is exactly 1 across all 53,367 transcript-region groups).
Every motif span is individually bordered, verified on a transcript containing one of the 9,838 same-cluster abutting pairs - the two motifs must be visually distinguishable.
UTR panels render RNA (U) by default and the protein panel never does; searching UCUCC finds TCTCC.

NTScore tracks render for both UTRs from the baked arrays and are length-aligned to the character grid at every wrap width; the protein panel shows pLDDT + InterPro ruler + UniProt features with the asymmetry stated in a caption.
All three empty states are exercised: a transcript with no 5'UTR motifs (one of 808), a cluster with no module (one of 387), and the TTN search path.
The R3->R1 handoff works: #/gene/<sym>?highlight=prot_0040,utr5_0004 pulses exactly those spans and scrolls the first into view.

phases.name: Phase 7 - R2: cluster pages and faceted browse (5 d)
phases.deliverable: V09 in both region variants, V11 with four tabs, the SVG logo renderer, and the partner-tier machinery.
exit_criteria: The SVG logo renderer draws IC-scaled logos from PWM arrays for both alphabets (4-letter ACGU and 20-letter protein) at three sizes, and is validated against a published logo image for at least three clusters.
Every cluster has a name and none renders as a bare id: 37 curated, 463 enriched, the rest synthesised from consensus + composition + size.

The 'no significant term' band renders as designed content for a cluster that has none (utr3_0215 has 0 of 77 rows passing; utr5_0090 and utr5_0096 likewise) and shows instance-level frequency instead.

The partner table defaults to strict (2,620 edges), shows the deliberate empty state for the 282 UTR / 99 protein clusters with no strict partner, and only relaxes behind a labelled toggle to npmi_mip_APC > 0.10 (7,210 edges). npmi_raw is not offered as a sort key anywhere on this page.
The triple FDR gate is a real control and the counts change when it is unchecked.
The m4_motif_examples acceptance fixture passes: utr5_0096 and utr3_0215 reproduce their hand-checked coverage and carrier numbers, and the UCUCC / utr3_0238 ambiguity warning fires automatically.
Every facet in browse shows its count before the click, and the 'no module' (387) / 'no logo' / 'no significant term' facets are present and usable.

phases.name: Phase 8 - R3: the three-level network (5 d)
phases.deliverable: V04 meta map, V05 cluster graph, V06 bipartite drill-down, V07 edge drawer, V08 node peek.
exit_criteria: The network opens on the 52-node published subset from bipartite_nodes_all6.csv and expands to 513 / 519 without re-laying out, because the coordinates are frozen.
Cross-module edges are ON by default; turning them off raises a non-dismissible warning naming the 28.9% and the M1<->M5 link.

The edge drawer puts the four gate bullet charts ABOVE the consensus and the annotations, with all four thresholds printed. Verified on prot_0040 x utr5_0004 (npmi 0.628, 23 clades, concentration 0.09, co 175, ZNF 0.00, score 1.7694).
The consensus section degrades through its three labelled tiers and NEVER shows an empty panel - checked specifically on a cross-module edge, where no consensus pair exists.
The carrier list is resolution-aware: switching between cluster and consensus level changes the count and the level is always printed.
The three isolated dyads (prot_0291 x utr5_0013, prot_0108 x utr3_0355, prot_0058 x utr3_0139) are shown in an 'ungrouped pairs' corner rather than floating unexplained.
The meta map's fifteen weights match the Phase 4 computation, and clicking M1-M5 opens the 192 edges the manuscript discusses.

phases.name: Phase 9 - The narrative front door: Atlas Home and six module stories (4.5 d)
phases.deliverable: V01, V03 x6 with their claim blocks and validation bands, and the four validation panels.
exit_criteria: Every number in every module claim sentence is data-bound and hoverable to its source; no number is typed into prose.
The evidence funnel renders on a log scale WITH the log scaling stated and the linear numbers printed, and each row deep-links to the corresponding filtered view.

All four validation panels show their non-significant results at full weight: the M5 2x2 shows all seven metrics including the four that are ns for the 'both' group; the APEX dumbbell shows lamina q=0.725 and OMM q=0.551 and says plainly that these do not support the manuscript sentence.
M4's validation band renders the explicit 'no external validation dataset in this project' state rather than being omitted.

The GO panel defaults to the trusted subset and reproduces module_leading_terms.csv counts exactly (M1 1,419 / M2 442 / M3 383 / M4 223 / M5 593 / M6 470 of 2,310 / 962 / 926 / 342 / 1,086 / 763), with the report's 'read the specificity, not the count' sentence printed above it.
M2's story card and claim block are GATED on the author's answer to the utr3_0027 / utr3_0227 question and ship with utr3_0227 plus an erratum note if confirmed.

phases.name: Phase 10 - Tours and Verify-a-figure (4 d)
phases.deliverable: The declarative tour runner, six shippable tours (the seventh gated on R-01), and the verify index with twelve panel pages.
exit_criteria: The runner is <=200 lines and knows nothing about any specific view: every step is {route, focus, highlight, prose, assertion, action} and dispatches into the target view's own control API.
Every step URL (#/tour/<id>?s=<n>) is deep-linkable and loads the underlying route first.
Every 'check it yourself' button performs a REAL interaction, not a narration advance, and the reader can leave mid-tour without losing their place or their filters.
Every assertion in every tour resolves against the same loaded data the view renders, so a tour cannot state a number the app does not show.
The Kozak tour runs end to end in under 5 minutes on a cold cache and ends on ACTB's real 5'UTR.

Each verify page carries one of the four verdict badges per claim with the measured value and its source file, and the two known ⚠ CONFLICT items (the APEX lamina/OMM sentence, and utr3_0027 vs utr3_0227) plus the Fig 4b n=667/460 open item are all rendered as such.
'Export this comparison' produces a stated-vs-measured CSV with source paths.

phases.name: Phase 11 - Evidence, methods, glossary, about-the-data (2 d)
exit_criteria: The paralogy page is reachable from the caveat strip in one click from anywhere in the app, and the raw-NPMI leaderboard is the ONLY sortable-by-npmi_raw table in the site.
The Meff gauge, the deflation triple-bar, the CMH table and the independent-origins comparison all render, each quoting relatedness_report.md or its source file.
Every caveat is quoted verbatim with its source file and section, never paraphrased.
The glossary covers all fifteen terms and every dotted term in the app opens it at the right entry.
The known-gaps register lists every material gap with its measured size and the workaround in use, and the region-mask self-check card shows all eight percentages reproducing exactly.
The provenance manifest table renders with a ⚠ on cca_winner_umap.npy and row_index.csv.

phases.name: Phase 12 - UMAP explorer and the isoform case study (1.5 d)
exit_criteria: 180,000 points render on canvas with quadtree hover at interactive frame rates, from the <=1 MB quantised payload, loaded only on that route.
The caption states that only 11,966 of 180,000 points belong to a module and that these are v3-tree coordinates joined to v4 scores.
Brushing produces a selection table that can be opened in the network.

The isoform page renders all three gene pairs from all_utr3_scores.npz with the ELAVL1 site overlay, and carries the explainer stating why isoform comparison is a fixed page rather than a generic feature.

phases.name: Phase 13 - QA, accessibility, performance, deploy, deposit (3.5 d)
phases.deliverable: A green fixture suite, an a11y pass, a measured performance budget, a deployed site and a Zenodo record.
exit_criteria: All seven acceptance fixtures pass in CI: ACTB, the m4 numbers, prot_0040 x utr5_0004, utr3_0463's 17 histones, the 142-cluster positional histogram reproduction, the TTN empty state, and the eight coverage percentages.

Performance budget met and recorded: first paint <= 334 KB; gene lookup <= 14 KB worst case; cluster open <= 217 KB worst case; module subgraph expand ~89 KB; the 519-node network interactive within 1 s of its bundle landing.

Accessibility: every interactive element is keyboard-reachable; motif spans and network nodes are focusable with visible focus; module is never encoded by colour alone (region shape and text labels are always present); prefers-reduced-motion is respected by the hero, the counters and the focus pulse; contrast passes in both themes.
Every table in every view has a working export, and provenance columns are on by default.
The repo lives in a LAB OR INSTITUTIONAL GitHub org, not a personal account - the single highest-risk item for long-term availability. Shards are generated in CI, not committed.
The built tree (~114 MB) is deposited to Zenodo, the concept DOI is in the footer chip and the citation block, and the snapshot version is visible in persistent chrome.

A README in the repo records the two scope questions still open (SOX2 design story, mouse) and the fact that the schema is species-keyed so mouse can be added by pointing at sequence_annotation_mouse/data/processed/.

critical_path: Phase 1 -> Phase 2 -> Phase 3 -> Phase 6 is the spine: nothing about R1 can be designed until the corrected master table exists, and nothing about R2's cluster page should be laid out until Phase 2 has told us how many of the 900 clusters actually end up with a logo. Phase 4 can run in parallel with Phase 3. Phases 9-12 depend on 6-8 being real views, because the tours drive those views rather than re-implementing them.
descope_order_if_time_runs_short: V15 pair UMAP explorer (nice; the network already carries the result)
V17 isoform case study (nice; five genes)
Bake step P9, the cross-module consensus association (the three-tier edge drawer already covers it)
VU-C1-13 MobiDB disorder track and VU-C1-12 UniProt feature track (the InterPro ruler alone carries the protein panel)
V13's CMH and independent-origins panels (the leaderboard and the Meff gauge carry the argument)
never_descope: The four gate bullet charts on every edge - they are the design's answer to the misreading risk
The three-tier cluster naming - without it 437 pages render as bare ids
The region mask on MobiDB / IDPO / SignalP - without it the site tells RNA biologists that 3'UTR motifs have intrinsic protein disorder
The inclusive-slice assertion - without it every highlight in the site is silently shifted
The persistent caveat strip and the co_occurrence field naming
